svg.title: Ash Harbor — Authoritative Physical Layout
svg.desc: Strict orthographic top-down technical map of a fictional coastal military-industrial region. North is up, east is right, and one SVG map unit equals ten meters.
svg.metadata: Source of truth: map-spec.yaml. Map frame: x -7000 to 7000 meters, z -5000 to 5000 meters. Projection: svg_x = 100 + (x + 7000) / 10; svg_y = 80 + (5000 - z) / 10.
svg.text: Authoritative physical layout · local Cartesian coordinates · meters
NORTH UP · EAST RIGHT · 1 SVG UNIT = 10 m

g.text: Region fills are diagrammatic; YAML geometry is authoritative.
